# Bulletin

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A read-only bulletin snapshot with Number, Valid, Path and HasAccess(). Display an accessible entry with DISPFILE.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#bulletins-and-news-400).

## HasAccess

```PPL
Bulletin.HasAccess() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Checks the current session against this snapshot's conference and bulletin security rules. FALSE for an invalid entry. Call before displaying Path with DISPFILE; it does not check file existence or command-level permissions.

## Number

`Bulletin.Number: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only zero-based Number, Valid flag, or configured display-file Path. Valid means a configured entry, not that its file exists. Add one to Number for the native BBS bulletin number. Display Path with DISPFILE after HasAccess().

## Path

`Bulletin.Path: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only zero-based Number, Valid flag, or configured display-file Path. Valid means a configured entry, not that its file exists. Add one to Number for the native BBS bulletin number. Display Path with DISPFILE after HasAccess().

## Valid

`Bulletin.Valid: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only zero-based Number, Valid flag, or configured display-file Path. Valid means a configured entry, not that its file exists. Add one to Number for the native BBS bulletin number. Display Path with DISPFILE after HasAccess().
